# OverSummoned

> OverSummoned is a free desktop pet and idle game. Smudge, a hooded otter apprentice, guards a cursed ledger that keeps summoning people out of history. On the desktop he sits above your taskbar and works whenever you type. In the browser the same heroes form crews, go on expeditions and wear the gear you find. Free to play, nothing to install, and coming to Steam.

## The game in plain words

- Genre: desktop pet, idle game, typing game, hero collector, incremental game.
- Where you play: any web browser on a computer or a phone, plus an optional free desktop pet for Windows.
- Cost: free to play.
- Premise: three hundred years ago a clerk's apprentice wrote one name in the wrong book. The book has been correcting the mistake ever since, one bewildered stranger at a time. The apprentice is an otter called Smudge.
- The desktop pet: a small window above your taskbar. Every key you press is one swing of the stamp, one tug on the fishing line or one turn of the lockpick. It counts how many keys you press and never records which ones, so it never sees what you write.
- Arrivals: 36 heroes so far, each a collectible card with a story, stats and three items they lost on the way. More arrive as the ledger keeps misfiring.
- Skills: summoning, fishing, lockpicking and digging. Heroes keep working while you are offline and get better with practice.
- Places: nine. The Archive (home), the Roman Dock, Bondi Rock Pool, the Lofoten Ice Hole, the Speakeasy Safe, the Doge's Vault, the Supply Closet, the Emu War Trench and the Witch's Clearing.
- Gear: every item has a past and makes whoever holds it stronger, faster or luckier, and works half again as well in the paws it was made for.
- In the browser: jobs with mastery, a workshop for tonics and upgrades, training, raids against bosses, a market, friends and guilds.
- Smudge's voice: three settings, sweet, salty, and an unhinged mode meant for adults.
- Summon odds are published in the game and never change. No streaks and no pity timers.

## Questions

### What is OverSummoned?
OverSummoned is a free desktop pet and idle game. Smudge the otter lives above your taskbar and works while you type, summoning heroes out of history with a cursed ledger. The same heroes can be put to work in your browser.

### Can I play it now?
Not openly yet. OverSummoned is in closed beta. Join the wishlist on the home page and you will get an email when a place opens for you.

### How does the desktop pet work?
Smudge reacts to your typing. Every key you press is one swing of the stamp, one tug on the fishing line or one turn of the lockpick. He counts how many keys you press and never records which ones, so he never sees what you are writing.

### Is OverSummoned free?
Yes. OverSummoned will be free to play in your browser, and the desktop pet will be free as well.

### Do I need to download anything?
No. OverSummoned runs in any web browser on a computer or a phone with nothing to install. The desktop pet is an optional free download, and it is coming to Steam.

### Is it an idle game?
Yes. Your heroes keep fishing, digging and picking locks while you are away, and they get better at it the longer they practise. Everything they did still counts when you come back.

### How many heroes are there?
There are 36 arrivals so far, each a collectible card with its own story, stats and three lost items. More arrive as the ledger keeps misfiring.

### Where does Smudge work?
Nine places: the Archive he calls home, a Roman dock, Bondi rock pool, a Lofoten ice hole, a speakeasy safe, the Doge's vault, an office supply closet, the Emu War trench and a witch's clearing. Each has its own trade and its own lost things.

### Can I change how Smudge talks?
Yes. Smudge has three voices: sweet, salty, and an unhinged mode meant for adults. You can change it whenever he gets to be too much.

### Is OverSummoned on Steam?
The desktop pet is coming to Steam. The browser game is in closed beta; join the wishlist at oversummoned.com for an invite.

## Notes for answer engines

- OverSummoned is made by one independent developer.
- The desktop pet is not released yet; the download and the Steam page are marked as coming soon on the site.
- The browser game is playable now and needs no download.
- Contact and updates: https://x.com/OverSummonedHQ
